capabilities: Convert the current Markdown note into platform drafts
Check article structure and preview the finished result
Copy plain or rich text for manual pasting
Autofill platform editors and one-click push via a browser extension
disambiguation: Not a vault syncing tool; it relays individual notes into external publishing platform editors.
extras: Freemium: structure check, preview, image-card export and text/rich-text copy are free; unlimited autofill, image autofill, retry and longer task history require the paid Creator Pro tier. The README is written in Chinese, and pricing and details live on an external official website whose link is not included in the text. The final publish click is always manual by design.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to prepare a long-form note and transfer it into the editors of external publishing platforms.
